h1: The 6 Best Paper Shredders for Staples and Paper Clips of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Shredders for Staples 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 6 best paper shredders that handle staples and paper clips, compared on sheet capacity, run time, bin size and security.
mainKeyword: shredder for staples and paper clips
summary: The Amazon Basics 15-Sheet is our pick for confirmed staple handling with a 20-minute run time. The Bonsaii 15-Sheet is the sturdy value choice. The Aurora AU1210MA is the micro-cut pick with a 60-minute run, and the Amazon Basics 8-Sheet is the cheapest.
intro: A shredder that jams on the first staple is useless for real paperwork. Plenty of shredders say they handle staples and paper clips, but the details that decide whether they cope daily, like run time and a reverse function, vary widely.
We ranked six shredders whose listings confirm staple or clip handling. We looked at sheet capacity, cut type, continuous run time and bin size from the spec sheets.

products.name: Amazon Basics 15-Sheet Cross Cut Paper Shredder for Home and Office
products.verdict: Confirmed staple tolerance with a long 20-minute run.
products.description:
This shredder takes 15 sheets at a time with a P-4 cross-cut and an 8.7-inch entry. It handles staples, small paper clips, CDs and credit cards, runs 20 minutes continuously and has a 6-gallon bin.

It ranks above the Bonsaii 15-Sheet for double the continuous run time and the bigger bin. The tradeoff is the $100-200 price bucket.

Best for households with regular paperwork. The caveat is that it costs more than the Bonsaii options.

products.name: Bonsaii 15-Sheet Cross Cut Paper Shredder for Home Office Heavy Duty
products.verdict: Alloy cutters and the same 15 sheets for under $100.
products.description:
The Bonsaii 15-Sheet has a P-4 cross-cut, alloy cutters and explicit handling of staples, clips, cards and CDs or DVDs. It runs 10 minutes and has a 5.5-gallon bin with a safety interlock.

It ranks below the Amazon Basics 15-Sheet for half the run time and a smaller bin. The tradeoff is a lower $50-100 bucket.

Best for staple-heavy use on a budget. The caveat is the shorter run.
products.idealFor: Buyers shredding staples regularly on a budget.

products.name: Aurora AU1210MA Professional Grade High Security 12-Sheet Micro-Cut Shredder
products.verdict: Micro-cut security with a 60-minute run time.
products.description:
The Aurora AU1210MA is a 12-sheet P-4 micro-cut shredder that destroys CDs, credit cards and paper clips. It runs 60 minutes continuously, has a 5-gallon bin and anti-jam auto-reverse.

It ranks third because micro-cut gives up some capacity compared with the 15-sheet models, but nothing here runs longer. The tradeoff is security versus headroom.

Best for sensitive documents. The caveat is the $100-200 price bucket.

products.name: Bonsaii 12-Sheet Cross Cut Heavy Duty Paper Shredder for Home Office
products.verdict: A jam-proof reverse made for clearing staple snags.
products.description:
This Bonsaii takes 12 sheets with a P-4 cross-cut and a jam-proof reverse for clearing staple and clip snags. It runs 15 minutes, about 900 sheets per cycle, with a 5.5-gallon bin.

It ranks below the 15-sheet picks on capacity but offers a longer run than the Bonsaii 15-Sheet. The tradeoff is capacity per pass.

Best for buyers who worry about jams. The caveat is the 12-sheet limit.
products.idealFor: Buyers who often hit staple jams.

products.name: Amazon Basics 12-Sheet Cross-Cut Paper and Credit Card Shredder
products.description:
The Amazon Basics 12-Sheet is a manual feed P-3 cross-cut that handles staples, small paper clips and credit cards. It runs 9 minutes and has a 5-gallon bin.

It ranks below the Bonsaii 12-Sheet for a shorter run and no stated reverse feature. The tradeoff is a lower security tier.

Best for everyday home use. The caveat is that P-3 is less secure than P-4.
products.skipIf: You need a higher security tier.

products.name: Amazon Basics 8-Sheet High Security Cross Cut Paper and Credit Card Shredder
products.verdict: The cheapest way to get confirmed staple tolerance.
products.description:
The Amazon Basics 8-Sheet is a P-4 cross-cut with 5x18mm particles that handles staples, small paper clips and credit cards. It runs 3 minutes and has a 3.7-gallon bin.

It ranks last for low capacity and short run, but it is the lowest-priced pick at $25-50. The tradeoff is endurance.

Best for light use. The caveat is the 3-minute run time.
products.idealFor: Light shredding on a tight budget.

whatMatters.detail: Cheap shredders can jam or dull on metal. A listing that confirms staples and clips is your protection. Look for the exact words in the specs, not just heavy duty.
A shredder overheats and stops after its run time. A 3-minute model stalls on a pile. Look for the number of minutes in the specs.
P-3, P-4 and micro-cut describe how fine the particles are. P-4 and micro-cut are better for sensitive papers. Look for the P rating or particle size.
A small bin means frequent emptying. A 5.5 or 6-gallon bin lasts longer. Check gallons on the listing.
Reverse backs out jammed paper and staples. It makes jams a minor chore. Look for reverse or anti-jam in the features.

faq.a: Yes, each listing confirms staple or small paper clip handling. Remove large binder clips first.

faq.q: What is the biggest buying mistake?
faq.a: Ignoring run time. A shredder that stops after 3 minutes frustrates anyone with a stack.

faq.q: Is the Aurora worth it over the Amazon Basics 15-Sheet?
faq.a: If you want micro-cut security and a 60-minute run, yes. For capacity, the 15-sheet is better.

faq.q: How do I clear a jam?
faq.a: Use the reverse function, then feed fewer sheets. The Bonsaii 12-Sheet has a jam-proof reverse.
The Amazon Basics models list credit card handling, and the Bonsaii 10-sheet notes one at a time. Check each manual.

faq.q: Why is the Bonsaii 15 Sheet cheaper?
faq.a: It sits in the $50-100 bucket with a 10-minute run time, versus 20 minutes on the Amazon Basics 15-Sheet.

finalTake: The Amazon Basics 15-Sheet is the best all-round shredder for staples and clips. The Bonsaii 15-Sheet is the budget-friendly alternative, and the Aurora is the secure pick for long sessions. Choose by run time and security first.
